_comment: How to read this template. See proposal-templates/README.md. Written per template because the parser cannot tell a reusable photograph from a diagram captioned with the previous client's name — both are a JPEG with an alt attribute.
_match: Which tenders this design is for. These words are used to choose between templates and are never copied into a proposal. Kept deliberately broad on the service side and specific on the subject side: the design suits any online or facilitated training assignment, and the child-protection terms are what distinguish it from the transport MEAL template next to it.
_images: None yet. This template was authored from a PDF and carries no photographs, logos or accreditation marks — every image in the source was a raster the conversion could not keep. Both lists stay empty and templates:check reports nothing to review. Add images and you must classify them here: nothing in the HTML separates a reusable team photograph from a diagram captioned with the last client's name.
